agt_notes: AGT has no cron/scheduled jobs: every recurring job runs as a loop inside this deployment (deploy/agt/scheduler.py).
AGT deploys accept GitHub URLs only; this manifest targets the public repo on branch main.
The deployment must operate independently: the development agent's computer does not need to remain online.

Secrets mapping: deploy/agt/secrets_mapping.md. Storage budget: deploy/agt/storage_budget.md. Backup + restore drill: deploy/agt/backup_recovery.md. Upgrade + rollback: deploy/agt/upgrade_rollback.md.

Phase 13 finalize (2026-11-22): void list live in deploy/agt/voided_closes.json (dashboard shows raw vs void-excluded totals); restore drill run against a scratch home with all steps passing (see ~/workspace/reports/phase13-finalize-2026-11-22.md); hourly backup now runs backup_verify --verify-latest after every backup. Still on-phone: the 2h full soak (supervisor + scheduler + traders), the phone-reboot running check, live Alchemy/Chainstack verification, and live benchmarks (Phase 10, UNMEASURED here) - procedures are in deploy/agt/README.md and deploy/agt/live_benchmarks.md.

description: Solana memecoin paper-trading bot (paper only, mainnet disabled) as an AGT deployment. Phase 13 finalize (2026-11-22) - see deploy/agt/README.md. Restore drill passed against a scratch home; 2h full soak and phone-reboot running check remain on-phone steps.
env_source: AGT vault (injected into the deployment process environment only, never the command line). No credential value appears in this manifest, in any file under deploy/, or in any log.

environment.FOREX_AGENT_HOME: deployment work dir + /.forex-agent (state root; also the deployment HOME on AGT)

name: meme-project-paper-bot

optional_env.name: HELIUS_API_KEY_DISCOVERY
optional_env.purpose: Second Helius key for research/discovery traffic, kept off the live signals' quota.

optional_env.name: HELIUS_API_KEY
optional_env.purpose: Helius main RPC key. SELECTIVE per the §9 architecture: required only for enriched Helius workloads (parsed streams/events/enrichment); the lane RPC tiers use it when present and otherwise fail over to the budgeted public endpoint.

optional_env.name: CHAINSTACK_ENDPOINT
optional_env.purpose: Full Chainstack Solana mainnet endpoint URL (the key is its final path segment). Required only when the router enables Chainstack (Phases 5-12 cutover; not the live leg today).

optional_env.name: HELIUS_ALERT_CHAT_ID
optional_env.purpose: Telegram chat id for Helius 429-spike alerts.

optional_env.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
optional_env.purpose: GitHub personal access token for the repo sync loop. Deferred to the finalize pass (the VM sync script uses the authd vault credential, which does not exist on AGT).

port_purpose: Read-only status dashboard (deploy/agt/status_server.py). AGT health-checks the port with a TCP connect; the tunnel publishes it. Binds 127.0.0.1 only.

required_env.name: ALCHEMY_API_KEY
required_env.purpose: Alchemy API key (key only, or a full RPC URL; both shapes resolve). PRIMARY routine acquisition leg per the user's §9 provider architecture, wired into the lane entry-critical reads 2026-11-23. Startup fails closed without it.

required_env.name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
required_env.purpose: Telegram bot token (alerts + control bot). Startup fails closed without it.
